messages:
alex_h: heads up — saw a clear p95 token latency jump after last runtime deploy (~10:42 UTC). attaching the quick perf dump I pulled from the instance.

alex_h: ```
summary: total samples: 1200
  kernel_select: 32%
  kv_lookup (misses+evict): 22%
  scheduler/queue_wait: 18%
  token_emit: 16%
  io/dispatch: 12%
```

alex_h: quick note: the model routing fell back to avx512-slow for long-context requests which looks correlated.

perf-bot: :rotating_light: perf-regression detected: metric=token_latency.p95, change=+28% vs baseline, link=https://perf.redwood/reports/1718274561

maria_w: thanks alex. can you paste the batch_size histogram from the same window? trying to see if batching policy caused more small batches.

alex_h: pasted below (1h window around deploy):

alex_h: ```
batch_size_histogram: counts
  1: 42%
  2-4: 30%
  5-8: 18%
  9-16: 8%
mean_batch_size: 2.8
queue_wait_ms.p95: 120ms (was 35ms pre-deploy)
```

jonathan_r: that queue_wait jump + small mean batch size smells like scheduler starvation. scheduler seems to be backing off to preserve latency but ends up with many tiny batches.

maria_w: also the KV cache telemetry shows an eviction storm at deploy time — looks like a slightly different model shard layout invalidated many entries. KV miss rate spiked to 38%.

jonathan_r: reproduction note: if sequence_len > 1024 the kernel selector currently maps to kernel_variant=v2_sliced which falls back to a slower matmul path when past 2048. we added that selector last sprint but didn't instrument kernel label in token-level traces.

alex_h: action items I propose:
- add per-token latency breakdown labels: kernel=..., scheduler_wait_ms, kv_hit/miss, io_ms, gen_ms (so dashboards can stack components)
- expose batch_size histogram with route/model_variant labels and p50/p95/p99 for queue_wait_ms
- add a per-route KPI panel that shows token_latency.p95 segmented by model_variant and kernel label
- add an alert when kv_miss_rate > 15% sustained for 5m for any route

maria_w: +1. for instrumentation specifics, suggest PromQL examples for the dashboards:

maria_w: ```promql
# token-level breakdown p95 for kernel time by model
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_token_kernel_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, route, model_variant, kernel))

# queue wait p95 by route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(scheduler_queue_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model_variant))

# batch size distribution (count)
sum(rate(runtime_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model_variant)
```

sre_ops: also add these telemetry labels: deploy_id, instance_pool (dedicated|hosted), seq_len_bucket (<=512, 513-1024, 1025-2048, >2048). makes drilling down easier when kernel selector misfires.

jonathan_r: for the short term we can cheat: patch kernel selector so long sequences prefer v2_chunked instead of v2_sliced when instance reports AVX2+ but not AVX512. should reduce the slow fallback. i'll open a tiny canary PR.

alex_h: can we also add a dashboard tile: "token latency waterfall" that stacks p95 contribution from [scheduler, kv, kernel, io, emit]? want to see root cause quickly.

maria_w: agreed. UX note: make the waterfall show absolute ms stacked (not percentages) and add a hover to show sample counts.

perf-bot: note: create ticket PERF-1723 for kernel selector rollback/canary + instrumentation. linked: https://issues.redwood/PERF-1723

alex_h: i'll own the PromQL panels and the waterfall config. jonathan, can you land the canary selector? maria, can you add kv eviction alert? sre_ops please add the deploy_id label to the runtime metrics pipeline.

maria_w: will add alert and include runbook snippet.

maria_w: runbook snippet:
```
if kv_miss_rate(route) > 15% for 5m:
  - check recent deploys (deploy_id)
  - if deploy changed shard layout, consider rolling back or triggering cache warmup job
  - check disk pressure and memory usage on KV hosts
```

jonathan_r: canary PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/482 — it defaults to off, but sets selector tweak and adds kernel label emission. testing on canary pool now.

alex_h: thx everyone. let's reconvene in ~30m to check p95 after canary. :thumbsup:

sre_ops: logging note: we also want to emit an event when kernel selection changes for a request: `kernel_selected=\"v2_sliced -> v2_chunked\"` so event timeline lights up in traces. low overhead counter is fine.

alex_h: agreed. adding to ticket.

maria_w: landing checklist for dashboards:
- token-level breakdown panels (p50/p95/p99)
- batch_size histogram + mean tile
- queue_wait p95 per-route
- KV miss rate heatmap by route
- waterfall panel with hover counts

jonathan_r: canary looks green so far on canary pool; queue_wait p95 dropped from 120ms -> 40ms for long-seq tests.

alex_h: excellent — closing loop here after 30m check. will update the ticket with dashboards links.

perf-bot: perf-regression auto-note cleared (token_latency.p95 returned within 5% of baseline).

alex_h: closing thread, filing final docs in PERF-1723. :white_check_mark:
